content.content: Error: Garmin login missing or expired. This server cannot read Garmin data until its owner signs in to Garmin again: run garmin-mcp-auth on the server, then restart it. Retrying will not help until then.

content.text:
I couldn't check how you're doing today because the connection to your Garmin account has expired, so I can't see any of your data right now.

**To fix it:** on the machine running the Garmin server, run `garmin-mcp-auth` to sign in to Garmin again, then restart the server. Trying again before that won't work.

Once you're signed back in, ask again and I'll look at last night's sleep, HRV, resting heart rate, Body Battery, training readiness and recent training load. Then I can tell you whether today is a good day to train hard or to take it easy.
